title: Accent Expert Gives a Tour of U.S. Accents - (Part One) | WIRED
summary: Dialect coach Erik Singer and several linguists tour distinct accents across English-speaking North America. It is the first part of a WIRED series on US accents.
why: HN recommends it as an enjoyable overview of American accents and what accent signals socially.

quote.text: I loved this video which does a tour of US accents.
